column1: What have been the trends and what are the prospects for European transport systems?
column2: 1990至2010年间，欧洲运输系统的发展趋势及其未来前景是什么？

column1: It is difficult to conceive of vigorous economic growth without an efficient transport system.
column2: 很难设想一个没有高效运输系统的经济体能够实现强劲的经济增长。

column1: Although modern information technologies can reduce the demand for physical transport by facilitating teleworking and teleservices, the requirement for transport continues to increase.
column2: 尽管现代信息技术通过促进远程工作和远程服务减少了对实体运输的需求，运输需求仍持续增长。

column1: There are two key factors behind this trend.
column2: 这一趋势的背后有两个关键因素。

column1: For passenger transport, the determining factor is the spectacular growth in car use.
column2: 在客运方面，决定因素在于汽车使用的急剧增加。

column1: The number of cars on European Union (EU) roads saw an increase of three million cars each year from 1990 to 2010, and in the next decade the EU will see a further substantial increase in its fleet.
column2: 从1990年到2010年，欧盟道路上的汽车数量每年增加300万辆。在接下来的十年里，欧盟的汽车数量还将进一步大幅增加。

column1: As far as goods transport is concerned, growth is due to a large extent to changes in the European economy and its system of production.
column2: 在货物运输方面，增长主要得益于欧洲经济及其生产体系的变化。

column1: In the last 20 years, as internal frontiers have been abolished, the EU has moved from a ‘stock’ economy to a ‘flow’ economy.
column2: 在过去20年里，随着内部边界的取消，欧盟已从一种以‘存量’为基础的经济模式转变为以‘流量’为基础的经济模式。

column1: This phenomenon has been emphasised by the relocation of some industries, particularly those which are labour intensive, to reduce production costs, even though the production site is hundreds or even thousands of kilometres away from the final assembly plant or away from users.
column2: 一些行业，尤其是劳动密集型行业，为降低生产成本而迁移生产地点，使这种现象更加突出，即使生产地距离总装厂或用户有数百甚至数千公里，也依然如此。
column8: labour intensive|adj. 劳动密集型的
column13: hundreds or even thousands of|数百甚至数千

column1: The strong economic growth expected in countries which are candidates for entry to the EU will also increase transport flows, in particular road haulage traffic.
column2: 预计将成为欧盟候选国的国家将实现强劲的经济增长，这将进一步推动运输流量的增长，尤其是公路货运量的上升。

column1: In 1998, some of these countries already exported more than twice their 1990 volumes and imported more than five times their 1990 volumes.
column2: 1998年，一些国家的出口量已超过1990年水平的两倍，进口量更是超过五倍。
column5: more than twice|adv. 超过两倍
column8: more than five times|超过五倍

column1: And although many candidate countries inherited a transport system which encourages rail, the distribution between modes has tipped sharply in favour of road transport since the 1990s.
column2: 尽管许多候选国继承了有利于铁路发展的交通体系，但自20世纪90年代以来，各种运输方式之间的比例已经明显向公路运输倾斜。

column1: Between 1990 and 1998, road haulage increased by 19.4%, while during the same period rail haulage decreased by 43.5%, although - and this could benefit the enlarged EU - it is still on average at a much higher level than in existing member states.
column2: 在1990年至1998年期间，公路运输量增加了19.4%，而铁路运输量则减少了43.5%。不过，这一情况对不断扩大的欧盟来说可能是有益的——因为总体而言，铁路运输量仍然比现有成员国要高得多。

column1: However, a new imperative - sustainable development - offers an opportunity for adapting the EU’s common transport policy.
column2: 然而，可持续发展这一新的迫切要求，为调整欧盟的共同运输政策提供了机会。
column8: common transport policy|共同运输政策

column1: This objective, agreed by the Gothenburg European Council, has to be achieved by integrating environmental considerations into Community policies, and shifting the balance between modes of transport lies at the heart of its strategy.
column2: 这一目标已由哥德堡欧洲理事会达成共识，必须通过将环境因素融入欧盟政策，并调整各类运输方式之间的平衡来实现，而这一平衡的调整正是其战略的核心。

column1: The ambitious objective can only be fully achieved by 2020, but proposed measures are nonetheless a first essential step towards a sustainable transport system which will ideally be in place in 30 years’ time, that is by 2040.
column2: 这一雄心勃勃的目标只有到2020年才能完全实现，但所提出的措施仍是迈向可持续运输体系的重要第一步，理想情况下，该体系将在30年后，即2040年建成。

column1: In 1998, energy consumption in the transport sector was to blame for 28% of emissions of CO₂, the leading greenhouse gas.
column2: 1998年，运输部门的能源消耗导致了28%的二氧化碳排放，而二氧化碳是主要的温室气体。

column1: According to the latest estimates, if nothing is done to reverse the traffic growth trend, CO₂ emissions from transport can be expected to increase by around 50% to 1,113 billion tonnes by 2020, compared with the 739 billion tonnes recorded in 1990.
column2: 根据最新估计，如果无法采取措施扭转交通增长趋势，到2020年，交通运输产生的二氧化碳排放量预计将增加约50%，达到1.113亿吨，而1990年时这一数字为739亿吨。

column1: Once again, road transport is the main culprit since it alone accounts for 84% of the CO₂ emissions attributable to transport.
column2: 再次强调，公路运输是主要的问题来源，因为公路运输所导致的二氧化碳排放占整个交通运输领域排放量的84%。

column1: Using alternative fuels and improving energy efficiency is thus both an ecological necessity and a technological challenge.
column2: 因此，采用替代燃料并提高能源效率，既是生态上的必然要求，也是技术上的挑战。

column1: At the same time greater efforts must be made to achieve a modal shift.
column2: 与此同时，还必须作出更大努力，推动运输方式的转变。
column3: At the same time|与此同时

column1: Such a change cannot be achieved overnight, all the less so after over half a century of constant deterioration in favour of road.
column2: 这种转变不可能一蹴而就，何况半个多世纪以来，运输格局愈发失衡，公路运输越来越占优势。
column5: all the less so|就更不可能如此
column6: over half a century|超过半个世纪

column1: This has reached such a pitch that today rail freight services are facing marginalisation, with just 8% of market share, and with international goods trains struggling along at an average speed of 18km/h.
column2: 这种失衡已严重到如下地步：如今铁路货运正面临边缘化，市场份额仅为8%，而国际货运列车行进缓慢，平均时速只有18公里。
column3: reached such a pitch|达到如此程度
column4: rail freight services|铁路货运服务

column1: Three possible options have emerged.
column2: 出现了三种可能的选项。

column1: The first approach would consist of focusing on road transport solely through pricing.
column2: 第一种方法是仅通过定价来聚焦公路运输。

column1: This option would not be accompanied by complementary measures in the other modes of transport.
column2: 这个选项不会与其他运输方式提供相应的配套措施。

column1: In the short term it might curb the growth in road transport through the better loading ratio of goods vehicles and occupancy rates of passenger vehicles expected as a result of the increase in the price of transport.
column2: 短期内，这项措施可能会抑制公路运输的增长，因为运价上涨后，货车的装载率和客车的载客率预计都会提高。
column3: In the short term|从短期看

column1: However, the lack of measures available to revitalise other modes of transport would make it impossible for more sustainable modes of transport to take up the baton.
column2: 然而，由于缺乏可使其他运输方式复苏的措施，更可持续的运输方式将无法接棒。

column1: The second approach also concentrates on road transport pricing but is accompanied by measures to increase the efficiency of the other modes (better quality of services, logistics, technology).
column2: 第二种方法同样关注公路运输的定价问题，但同时也会采取措施提升其他运输方式的效率，例如提升服务质量、优化物流流程、采用先进技术。

column1: However, this approach does not include investment in new infrastructure, nor does it guarantee better regional cohesion.
column2: 然而，这种做法并未包括对新型基础设施的投资，也无法确保地区间的更好融合。

column1: It could help to achieve greater uncoupling than the first approach, but road transport would keep the lion’s share of the market and continue to concentrate on saturated arteries, despite being the most polluting of the modes.
column2: 它可能有助于实现比第一种方法更彻底的解耦，但公路运输仍将占据市场最大份额，并继续集中在交通拥堵严重的路段上运行——尽管公路运输是污染最严重的一种运输方式。

column1: It is therefore not enough to guarantee the necessary shift of the balance.
column2: 因此，仅仅保证平衡状态的转变是不够的。

column1: The third approach, which is not new, comprises a series of measures ranging from pricing to revitalising alternative modes of transport and targeting investment in the trans-European network.
column2: 第三种方法并不新鲜，它包含了一系列措施：从定价策略到推动替代交通方式的发展，再到吸引投资以完善跨欧洲网络的建设。

column1: This integrated approach would allow the market shares of the other modes to return to their 1998 levels and thus make a shift of balance.
column2: 这种综合方法将使其他运输方式的市场份额恢复到1998年的水平，从而实现平衡的转换。

column1: It is far more ambitious than it looks, bearing in mind the historical imbalance in favour of roads for the last fifty years, but would achieve a marked break in the link between road transport growth and economic growth, without placing restrictions on the mobility of people and goods.
column2: 它比看起来更雄心勃勃，考虑到过去五十年道路运输一直占据优势，但将显著打破道路运输增长与经济增长之间的联系，而不会限制人员和货物的流动性。
